name: Escape Room (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 noise instrument built as a puzzle. Five coupled noise cells — a geiger cloud, a chaotic FM pair, wandering formants, inharmonic strings, and a crusher that eats the room's own output — through a playable four-voice resonant filter, three effects, and a six-bit lock that rewires the whole machine into any of sixty-four reproducible rooms. Nothing on the panel is labelled with what it does, and there is a legend hidden in the door.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.1 · free download · 15-page manual included.
